# API endpoints

Three APIs, each its own program: **platform** (platform-api.sugrpay.com), **sugrpay**
(sugrpay-api.sugrpay.com) and **hq** (hq-api.sugrpay.com, not built yet). The API column says which one
serves each route; api.sugrpay.com also accepts every route and passes it on to the right one. The rule
is `apiServiceFor` in `packages/platform-contracts/src/api-routing.ts`. **Internal** routes answer only the
other APIs (shared INTERNAL_API_KEY; refused from the internet).

<!-- Generated by scripts/api-reference.mjs from the controllers. Do not edit by hand:
     change the code (or the description in that script) and run `pnpm docs:api`. -->

132 endpoints (51 POST, 61 GET, 13 PATCH, 1 DELETE, 6 PUT); 22 public. How to call them — sign-in, errors, pagination, money — is in [README.md](README.md).

**Access** is the permission the caller's role must hold (`RESOURCE:ACTION`, see
[products-and-access](../architecture/products-and-access.md)); `INVOICING` means the company must subscribe to
Sugrpay and the user must hold a Sugrpay role. Routes under `/brands/:brandId` also require the brand to be one
the user can reach. **Request** names the schema the body (or query string) is validated against — in
`packages/invoicing-contracts/src/schemas.ts` or `packages/platform-contracts/src/schemas.ts`.

## Internal (API to API)

| API      | Method | Path                                         | Access            | Request                     | Response                              | What it does                                                                                                                                |
| -------- | ------ | -------------------------------------------- | ----------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| platform | POST   | `/internal/audit`                            | internal key only | body `auditSchema`          | 204 no body                           | Platform: writes an entry to the platform's append-only audit log.                                                                          |
| platform | GET    | `/internal/brands/:brandId/stripe-account`   | internal key only | —                           | `{ accountId: string \| null }`       | Platform: the brand's connected Stripe account id, for taking a card payment.                                                               |
| platform | POST   | `/internal/brands/:brandId/theme-color`      | internal key only | body `themeColorSchema`     | 200 `{ ok: true }`                    | Platform: sets a brand's colour (Sugrpay's branding screens edit it; the brand is the platform's).                                          |
| sugrpay  | POST   | `/internal/events`                           | internal key only | body `deliveredEventSchema` | 204 no body                           | Sugrpay: receives a platform event (brand created/updated, …) from the platform outbox; a failure makes the platform retry.                 |
| platform | POST   | `/internal/sessions/resolve`                 | internal key only | body `resolveSessionSchema` | 200 `{ scope: RequestScope \| null }` | Platform: who a session token belongs to (the caller's scope, or null). What a product API's request guard asks on every signed-in request. |
| platform | GET    | `/internal/stripe-accounts/:accountId/brand` | internal key only | —                           | `{ brandId: string \| null }`         | Platform: which brand a Stripe connected account belongs to, for routing a Stripe webhook.                                                  |

## Sign-in

| API      | Method | Path                       | Access                      | Request                           | Response                                                            | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| -------- | ------ | -------------------------- | --------------------------- | --------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| platform | POST   | `/auth/forgot-password`    | public                      | body `forgotPasswordSchema`       | 202 `{ ok: true }`                                                  | Emails a password-reset link. Always answers the same way, so it does not reveal which emails exist.                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| platform | POST   | `/auth/login`              | public                      | body `loginSchema`                | 200 `{ token: string; expiresAt: string; user: AuthenticatedUser }` | Signs in with email and password. Returns the session token (also set as a cookie) and its expiry. Locks the account after 5 failures in 15 minutes.                                                                                                                                                                      |
| platform | POST   | `/auth/logout`             | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | —                                 | 204 no body                                                         | Ends the current session.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| platform | GET    | `/auth/me`                 | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | —                                 | `CurrentUserResponse`                                               | The signed-in user: role, company, brands, products, product roles, locations and permissions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| platform | POST   | `/auth/register`           | public                      | body `registerSchema`             | 201 `Promise<`                                                      | Sign Up with a company email and a password (12+ characters). Free email providers are refused; one account per email across every company (409 EMAIL_TAKEN). Creates the company with the person as its Company Admin, signs them in (token, as login) and returns nextStep REGISTER_COMPANY. No product is enabled yet. |
| platform | POST   | `/auth/set-password`       | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | body `setPasswordSchema`          | 200 `{ ok: true }`                                                  | Signed-in user replaces a temporary password.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| platform | POST   | `/auth/set-password/token` | public                      | body `setPasswordWithTokenSchema` | 200 `{ token: string; expiresAt: string; user: AuthenticatedUser }` | Sets a password from an emailed link (sign-up, invitation or reset) and signs the user in.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

## Company and onboarding

| API      | Method | Path                                  | Access                      | Request                         | Response                                                   | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| -------- | ------ | ------------------------------------- | --------------------------- | ------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| platform | GET    | `/company/products`                   | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | —                               | `ProductsView`                                             | Select Your Products: the fixed list (Sugrpay, HQ) with name, description, whether each is enabled and whether this user may enable it; and whether onboarding is complete.                                                                                                                                    |
| platform | POST   | `/company/products`                   | `PLAN_AND_BILLING:WRITE`    | body `enableProductsSchema`     | 200 `EnabledProducts`                                      | Enables the selected products (Company Admin; at least one, no repeats). 409 COMPANY_NOT_REGISTERED / ADD_BRAND_FIRST before those steps. Completes onboarding. continueWith names the product to open straight away when exactly one is enabled.                                                              |
| platform | POST   | `/company/products/:product/continue` | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | —                               | 200 `ProductLaunch`                                        | Continue into a product: returns its URL and a 15-minute JWT (HS256; sub user, mid company, aud product). Only for a product enabled for the company (409 PRODUCT_NOT_ENABLED); 409 PRODUCT_NOT_AVAILABLE when the product has no web address yet (HQ until HQ_PUBLIC_URL is set).                             |
| platform | GET    | `/company/subscriptions`              | `PLAN_AND_BILLING:READ`     | —                               | `ProductSubscription[]`                                    | The company's products and whether each is switched on.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| platform | PUT    | `/company/subscriptions/:product`     | `PLAN_AND_BILLING:WRITE`    | body `updateSubscriptionSchema` | `ProductSubscription`                                      | Switches a product on or off for the company (no billing provider yet). Switching one on needs a registered company with a brand, and completes onboarding.                                                                                                                                                    |
| platform | POST   | `/merchant/first-brand`               | `BRANDS:WRITE`              | body `firstBrandSchema`         | `{ brand: CreatedBrandSummary; nextStep: OnboardingStep }` | Add Your Brand (Company Admin): the company's first brand, active. Legal Name, Display Name, Currency and a valid IANA Timezone are required; Theme Color optional. 409 COMPANY_NOT_REGISTERED before Register Your Company; 409 BRAND_ALREADY_ADDED if a brand exists. Returns nextStep SELECT_PRODUCTS.      |
| platform | GET    | `/merchant/onboarding`                | `ORGANISATION_PROFILE:READ` | —                               | `MerchantOnboardingState`                                  | Where onboarding stands: nextStep (REGISTER_COMPANY, ADD_BRAND or SELECT_PRODUCTS), worked out from the data; the registered company; whether it has brands and has completed onboarding. Signing in goes to nextStep.                                                                                         |
| platform | POST   | `/merchant/register-company`          | `BRANDS:WRITE`              | body `registerCompanySchema`    | 200 `{ nextStep: OnboardingStep }`                         | Register Your Company (Company Admin): Company Name (unique across companies, ignoring case and spacing; 409 COMPANY_NAME_TAKEN), Legal Name, Tax ID and Brand Structure, all required. Once per company (409 COMPANY_ALREADY_REGISTERED). The contact email is the sign-up email. Returns nextStep ADD_BRAND. |

| sugrpay | POST   | `/brands/:brandId/invoices/:id/issue`         | `INVOICE_SEND:WRITE` | —                                   | `InvoiceWithLines`                                | Issues a draft: it gets its final number, becomes SENT and its payment link goes live.                                                                                                                                       |

| sugrpay | GET    | `/brands/:brandId/invoices/summary`           | `INVOICES:READ`      | —                                   | `InvoiceSummary`                                  | Outstanding amount and count of open invoices.                                                                                                                                                                               |
| sugrpay | GET    | `/brands/:brandId/invoices/tab-counts`        | `INVOICES:READ`      | query `invoiceTabCountsQuerySchema` | `InvoiceTabCounts`                                | Counts for the All / Draft / Unpaid / Partial / Paid / Overdue tabs.                                                                                                                                                         |

## Public payment pages and webhooks

| API       | Method | Path                                                | Access | Request                                              | Response                 | What it does                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------- | ------ | --------------------------------------------------- | ------ | ---------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| sugrpay   | GET    | `/public/invoices/:token`                           | public | —                                                    | `PublicInvoiceView`      | The customer's view of an invoice by its payment-link token: amounts, lines, brand look, accepted methods. Records the first view.                                                                             |
| sugrpay   | POST   | `/public/invoices/:token/checks`                    | public | body `createCheckSubmissionSchema`, multipart upload | `{ id: string }`         | The customer uploads a check: number, amount, front and back images (multipart, up to 10 MB each).                                                                                                             |
| sugrpay   | POST   | `/public/invoices/:token/payment-intents`           | public | body `createIntentBodySchema`                        | `PaymentAttemptResult`   | Starts a payment for the invoice (card, wallet or ACH) with the configured gateway.                                                                                                                            |
| sugrpay   | POST   | `/public/invoices/:token/payment-intents/reconcile` | public | body `paymentIntentReconcileSchema`                  | `PaymentAttemptResult`   | After the browser confirms a card payment, asks the gateway for the real outcome (fallback when the webhook has not arrived).                                                                                  |
| sugrpay   | GET    | `/public/invoices/:token/pdf`                       | public | —                                                    | no body                  | The invoice as a PDF.                                                                                                                                                                                          |
| sugrpay   | POST   | `/public/webhooks/fake-gateway`                     | public | —                                                    | 200 `{ received: true }` | Payment events from the built-in test gateway (signature verified; local testing only).                                                                                                                        |
| sugrpay   | POST   | `/public/webhooks/mail`                             | public | —                                                    | 200 `{ received: true }` | Mail delivery events (delivered, bounced, spam complaint) for invoice emails, signed with MAIL_WEBHOOK_SECRET. A bounce or complaint is added to the invoice timeline. See docs/integrations/mail-delivery.md. |
| every API | GET    | `/storage/local`                                    | public | —                                                    | no body                  | Serves an uploaded file by signed, expiring link when files are stored on local disk (not used with S3).                                                                                                       |

## Health

| API       | Method | Path             | Access | Request | Response                                 | What it does                                                              |
| --------- | ------ | ---------------- | ------ | ------- | ---------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| every API | GET    | `/health`        | public | —       | no body                                  | Overall status, environment, active adapters and each dependency's state. |
| every API | GET    | `/health/live`   | public | —       | `{ status: 'ok' }`                       | Liveness: the process is running.                                         |
| sugrpay   | GET    | `/health/queues` | public | —       | `Record<string, Record<string, number>>` | Job queue sizes and states.                                               |
| every API | GET    | `/health/ready`  | public | —       | no body                                  | Readiness: databases, Redis and storage reachable.                        |
